Area.evidence_source: Anxiety disorders (Sareen, 2011), symptoms (Busch et al., 2003) and trait anxiety (Brezo et al., 2008) have all been linked with suicidal behaviour. ... Trust is also inherently relational. Løgstrup (1997, p18) emphasises the fundamental necessity of trust for living. Trust helps people bond, integrate meaningfully into a community, and gain 'social capital' (Kawachi et al., 1997).
